title: documentation: Links to anchors not always scroll to the correct part of the page
body:
* Click on [this link](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/documentation/#refinementlist) to open in a new tab
* Wait for the page to load in the new tab
* Go to the tab
* The page is not scrolled to #refinementList as it should, but goes to hierarchicalMenu

This is weird, and sometimes reloading the page does not seem to solve it. I think this comes from the anchor.js library we're using, I had the same issue on some of our main documentation pages in the past. Still unsure where it's coming from.
